content:
The Webb County Community Action Agency is offering free diapers and feminine hygiene products to eligible families in Webb County, while supplies last.

Available items include diapers in newborn, size 1, limited size 2, and size 3, as well as menstrual underwear in sizes small, medium, and large, and feminine hygiene pads.

To qualify, families must live in Webb County, receive WIC, SNAP, or CEAP benefits, and have a household income at or below 150 percent of the federal poverty level. Proof of eligibility is required, and supplies are distributed once every three months per household.

The agency is open Monday through Friday from 8:00 a.m. to 4:00 p.m. at two locations: the Fernando Salinas Community Center, 520 Reynolds Street, second floor, and the main CAA office at 111 Camino Nuevo Road, Highway 359.

For more information, call 956-523-4222.

Sources: Webb County Community Action Agency.
